task_pattern: Notification retry policy for transient delivery failures
description: Fix notification delivery retries by routing transient provider failures through src/retryPolicy.js while keeping permanent failures non-retryable.
solution_steps: Inspect the failing notification channel tests before changing retry behavior.
Keep retry decisions centralized in src/retryPolicy.js.
Treat transient email provider errors such as SMTP_TEMP as retryable.
Treat permanent email provider errors such as SMTP_PERM as non-retryable.
Run the retry policy test suite.
pitfalls: Do not retry every provider error; permanent failures should stop.
Do not implement channel-specific retry logic in individual senders when src/retryPolicy.js is the shared policy.
